desc:
CRAVING CRUSHER: A remix of traditional Chex Mix Snack Mix loaded with flavors inspired by the tangy deliciousness of a Buffalo sandwich

CUE THE CRUNCH: Features a crispy, savory blend of Spices and Herbs Chex, Buffalo Sauce Chex, Ranch flavored wing puffs, and toasted breadsticks

PARTY FAVORITE: Endless taste and texture combinations make it the perfect party mix snack for get-togethers of all shapes and sizes; Not your standard pub mix, trail mix, or bar snack

EASY SNACK: Stock up on bags to share at home, at work, or anytime you're craving the taste of a Buffalo sandwich

CONTAINS: One 11 oz family size bag of Chex Mix Remix Buffalo Sandwich Snack Mix
features:
Key Features:

Buffalo Sandwich-Inspired Flavor

A bold combination of tangy buffalo seasoning and savory sandwich-inspired tastes.

Crunchy Mix of Ingredients

Includes flavored Chex pieces, ranch-style puffs, and seasoned breadsticks for variety in texture.

Family Size Pack

Comes in an 11 oz bag, ideal for sharing at parties, road trips, or family snacking.

Ready-to-Eat Convenience

No prep required—just open and enjoy.

Allergen Info

Contains wheat, milk, and soy.

Benefits:

Flavorful and Satisfying

A spicy and savory snack that satisfies buffalo cravings in a crunchy format.

Perfect for Social Settings

Great for game nights, gatherings, or lunchbox snacks.

Fun Texture Variety

Offers a mix of crunchy, airy, and crisp textures in every handful.

Portion-Friendly

Easy to control servings from a resealable family-size bag.
ingredients:
Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Whole Wheat, Vegetable Oil (soybean, palm kernel, sunflower, palm, high oleic soybean, canola and/or olive), Enriched Flour (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Maltodextrin, Sugar, Corn Meal. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Whey Powder, Yeast Extract, Seasoning Mix (buttermilk, salt, whey, yeast extract, milk, spice, whey protein concentrate, milk fat powder, garlic powder, sour cream [cream, nonfat milk, cultures], onion powder, sugar, tomato powder, dextrose, maltodextrin, natural flavor, cultured buttermilk, citric acid, parsley), Yeast, Color (paprika extract, red 40 lake), Dried Cayenne Pepper Sauce (cayenne pepper, vinegar, salt, garlic), Corn Starch, Natural Flavor, Spice, Dextrose, Brown Sugar, Onion Powder, Citric Acid, Garlic Powder, Distilled Monoglycerides, Soy Lecithin, Gum Arabic, Baking Soda, Trisodium Phosphate, Calcium Carbonate, Spice Extract, Vinegar, Modified Corn Starch, Lactic Acid, Malic Acid, Sodium Diacetate, Calcium Lactate, Sodium Citrate. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
